name: Dashashwamedh Ghat
address: Dashashwamedh Ghat Road, Bangali Tola, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: The heartbeat of Varanasi’s riverfront. Mythologically associated with Lord Brahma’s 10-horse sacrifice, this iconic ghat is famous worldwide for the mesmerizing daily evening Maha Ganga Aarti.
visitorTip: Arrive by 5:45 PM to grab a front-row stone step or hire a traditional wooden rowing boat from the river side for the most cinematic Aarti views.

name: Assi Ghat
address: Shivala, Assi Ghat, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: Located where the sacred river Assi meets the Ganga. Famous for the tranquil Subah-e-Banaras morning sunrise programme, yoga sessions, live Indian classical music, and vibrant youth cafes.
visitorTip: Best visited at dawn (5:30 AM) for morning Shehnai recitals, tea in earthen kulhads, and peaceful sunrise walks toward Chet Singh Ghat.
timing: Open 24 Hours • Morning Aarti at 5:30 AM

name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple
address: Vishwanath Gali, Lahori Tola, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: One of the twelve supreme Jyotirlingas of Lord Shiva. The newly expanded Vishwanath Corridor connects the golden-spired sanctum sanctorum seamlessly with the banks of the Ganga.
visitorTip: Strict security check. Mobile phones, electronic lockers, and leather belts must be deposited at the official facilitation counters. Carry original government ID.

name: Sankat Mochan Hanuman Temple
address: Sankat Mochan Road, Saket Nagar, Durgakund, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: Established by Saint Goswami Tulsidas, author of Ramcharitmanas. Dedicated to Lord Hanuman, the reliever of all troubles. Revered for pure spiritual peace and special Besan Laddoo prasadam.
visitorTip: Visit on Tuesday or Saturday morning. Watch out for resident monkeys—keep prasad bags discreetly concealed.

name: Banaras Hindu University (BHU)
address: Ajagara, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: Founded in 1916 by Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya, this 1,300-acre lush green campus is one of Asia’s largest residential universities, home to the magnificent New Vishwanath Temple (VT) and Bharat Kala Bhavan museum.
visitorTip: Rent a bicycle or take an e-rickshaw to visit the marble VT temple, followed by famous cold coffee and chola bhatura at the VT canteen.

name: Varanasi Junction (Cantt)
address: Cantt Station Road, Hukulganj, Varanasi, UP 221002
description: The primary gateway station linking Varanasi with major express trains across India. Features modernized air-conditioned waiting lounges, prepaid auto stands, and direct bus connectivity.
visitorTip: Use official Prepaid Auto/Taxi booths located right outside Gate 1 to avoid inflated prices to Godowlia or Assi.

name: Kashi Chaat Bhandar
address: D.53/98, Luxa Road, Near Godowlia Crossing, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: World-renowned street food institution. Famous for authentic Banarasi hot Tamatar Chaat served in terracotta bowls (kullad), Palak Chaat, and Dahi Gujiya.
visitorTip: Order the piping hot Tamatar Chaat sprinkled with desi ghee and spiced sugar syrup. Best visited around 5:30 PM before peak evening rush.

name: Blue Lassi Shop
address: CK 12/1, Kunj Gali, Near Manikarnika Ghat, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Operating since 1925 in narrow alleyways, hand-churning thick curd with over 80 seasonal fruit and dry-fruit toppings served in earthen cups with passport photos from travelers worldwide.
visitorTip: Try the Pomegranate-Pistachio or Banana-Almond Lassi topped with fresh thick Malai and Rabri.

name: Chet Singh Ghat & Fort
address: Shivala Ghats, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Imposing 18th-century stone fortress built by Maharaja Chet Singh, site of the fierce battle against Warren Hastings in 1781. The massive bastions and stone ramparts offer breathtaking photography.
visitorTip: In the golden hour (4:30 PM – 5:30 PM), the sandstone fortress reflects magnificently in the calm river waters.

name: Manikarnika Ghat
address: Near Chowk, Manikarnika Gali, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: The holiest cremation ghat where fires have burned continuously for millennia. According to Hindu belief, attaining Moksha (liberation from cycle of rebirth) occurs here.
visitorTip: Maintain utmost solemnity and quiet respect. Photography of the pyres is strictly prohibited and offensive to grieving families.

name: Kaal Bhairav Mandir
address: K-32/22, Bharonath, Golgadda, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Dedicated to Kaal Bhairav, the fierce manifestation of Shiva revered as the Kotwal (Chief Police Officer/Guardian) of Varanasi. Tradition dictates seeking his blessings before entering or leaving the city.
visitorTip: Priests tie black consecrated protective threads (Ganda) on wrists. Purchase mustard oil and black sesame seeds outside for the holy lamp.

name: Aum Café
address: B.1/201, Assi Ghat, Near Ganges View Hotel, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: Charming organic cafe run with love, serving Ayurvedic lemon-ginger honey teas, vegan pancakes, freshly roasted South Indian pour-overs, and home-baked gluten-free treats.
visitorTip: Great spot for remote work or peaceful reading with fast Wi-Fi and chilled cinnamon iced teas.

name: Brown Bread Bakery & Rooftop
address: D 25/42, Pandey Ghat, Bangali Tola, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Varanasi’s first organic bakery providing artisanal European sourdough, over 30 varieties of cheese, Italian pasta, and evening live Indian classical violin and sitar performances on the rooftop.
visitorTip: Head to the 4th floor rooftop terrace around sunset for organic pasta with uninterrupted views of the river.

name: Sir Sunderlal Hospital & Trauma Centre (BHU)
address: BHU Main Campus Road, Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: State-of-the-art super-speciality government teaching hospital with 24/7 Level-1 emergency trauma centre, cardiology, neurology, and advanced critical care units.
visitorTip: Emergency entrance is accessible directly via BHU South Gate on Lanka road.

name: Apollo 24/7 Pharmacy Godowlia
address: Near Godowlia Chauraha, Luxa Road, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Well-stocked round-the-clock pharmacy offering emergency medicines, first-aid kits, water purification tablets, ORS, prescription drugs, and baby care essentials.
visitorTip: Accepts all credit cards, UPI, and maintains cold storage for insulin and sensitive medicines.

name: State Bank of India 24x7 ATM Hub
address: Main Chowk Road, Near Girjaghar Crossing, Godowlia, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: High-capacity State Bank of India ATM center with 4 cash-dispensing kiosks supporting domestic and international Visa/Mastercard cards with backup solar generators.
visitorTip: Always carry a small amount of cash in ₹100 and ₹500 denominations for local boatmen, tea stalls, and rickshaws.

name: Namo Ghat (Khidkiya Ghat)
address: Rajghat Road, Northern Waterfront, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Newly developed modern riverfront featuring iconic large metal folded-hands "Namaste" sculptures, food court, CNG boat refueling hub, open amphitheatre, and helipad.
visitorTip: Very pedestrian-friendly and wheelchair accessible with dedicated walkways, evening fountain lightings, and boat rides.

name: Sarnath Archaeological Site & Dhamek Stupa
hindiName: सारनाथ पुरातत्व परिसर एवं धमेक स्तूप
address: Sarnath, Varanasi, UP 221007 (10 km from Cantt)
description: Where Lord Buddha preached his first sermon (Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta) after attaining enlightenment. Home to the massive 43-meter cylindrical Dhamek Stupa and Ashoka Lion Pillar.
visitorTip: Combine with the adjacent Archaeological Museum housing the original Ashokan Lion Capital (National Emblem of India). Closed Fridays.

name: Sulabh International Deluxe Toilet Complex
address: Upper Promenade, Assi Ghat, Varanasi, UP 221005
description: Maintained public sanitation complex with running water, clean European and Indian water-closets, bathing cubicles, and handwashing basins.
visitorTip: Keep small coins/cash handy for the ₹5 maintenance fee.

name: Godowlia Multi-Level Smart Parking
address: Near Godowlia Crossing & Girjaghar, Varanasi, UP 221001
description: Modern municipal 4-tier parking garage. Vehicles entering the pedestrianized Dashashwamedh corridor must park here.
visitorTip: Crucial for visitors driving cars or hired two-wheelers. Cars cannot enter the ghat zone past this point after 9:00 AM.
